name: delegation
help:
usage: work delegation [-h] {validate,build} ...

positional arguments:
  {validate,build}
    validate        Check an internal role envelope without granting
                    authority.
    build           Build a role envelope from formal source and semantic
                    input.

options:
  -h, --help        Return command help in a JSON response.

children.name: validate
build
children.help:
usage: work delegation build [-h] --input-file INPUT_FILE [--skill-root SKILL_ROOT]

options:
  -h, --help            Return command help in a JSON response.
  --input-file INPUT_FILE
  --skill-root SKILL_ROOT
